title: Jelly Tunnel | Cabrillo Marine Aquarium 🪼
description:
Step inside the Jelly Lab at Cabrillo Marine Aquarium and get an up-close look at moon jellies and purple-striped jellies drifting through the water. Watch as these mesmerizing creatures pulse and glide through the glowing exhibits, offering a peaceful glimpse into the fascinating world of marine invertebrates.

The Jelly Lab supports education and research while helping visitors learn more about the delicate life found beneath the surface of the Pacific Ocean.

Discover the beauty of these incredible jellies during your next visit: https://cma.recreation.parks.lacity.gov/
